# Serhiy Oplakanets

> Personal website of Serhiy Oplakanets — co-founder at Rebbix and Rove.me. Entrepreneur and engineer at heart, competitive angler, husband and father of two.

## About

Serhiy Oplakanets is a startup founder and entrepreneur. His main focus is Rebbix, which he co-founded in 2012 — a company that builds dedicated product engineering teams for startups and enterprises. He has also co-founded Rove.me, a travel discovery platform, BaseB, and a few other ventures. His background is engineering — 20+ years in software — which still shapes how he builds companies and teams. Outside of work he is a husband and a father of two, and competes in sports fishing tournaments.
